title: 第21章 家族议会第22章 新的任务
slug: 打造万古家族开局奖励极道帝兵
lines: 翌日清晨。
青枫谷，家族议事堂。
六位家族长老已经早早的在议事堂等着了。
“二长老，没想到你不声不响的竟然突破到了肉身大圆满，实在是可喜可贺啊。”
几位长老喜笑颜开的的向二长老祝贺道。
二长老哈哈一笑，捋了捋胡子，一脸谦虚的道：“侥幸罢了，你们几个也要加把劲啊，时不我待，留给我们这些老东西的时间已经不多了。”
三长老李玄庸叹了口气。
摇了摇头道：“我资质太差了，这辈子可能也就这样了，我还是好好的替家主看着钱袋子吧。”
众人闻言，皆是莞尔一笑。
几人有一句没一句的闲聊着。
直到门外，一道响亮的声音响起......
“家主到！”
李行歌迈着沉稳的步伐，大步走了进来。
待李行歌大马金刀的在家主之位落座后，除大长老外的几位长老齐齐起身，拱手抱拳道：“我等见过家主。”
“诸位长老请坐。”
李行歌笑着道。
看到众人又重新坐了回去，李行歌便宣布，今天的家族议会正式开始。
“家主，与莽山苏氏一战，具体的伤亡情况已经统计出来了。”
大长老率先道。
“在此战中，我李家修士战死17人，伤残9人，皆为锻体境修士。”
李行歌听完，点了点头，神情有些沉重的道。
“我李家战死之人，一次性发放抚恤金五十两，伤残之人，二十两，再根据其自身情况，安排合适差事，一应参战族人，皆赏金五两。”
众人对李行歌的安排，都没有意见。
这时，大长老又道：“家主，在此战中，郝家为我李家而战，也付出了不小的伤亡，我李家是否也应该有所表示，否则，恐世人寒心，言我李家凉薄。”
李行歌想了想，觉得大长老说的没错，灭苏家一战，郝家出力甚多。
那位被他赐名郝忠离的郝家家主，更是斩杀了一位苏家的肉身境修士。
于是点头道：“大长老言之有理，那便赏金五百两，另外，在将溪眉山的那座小铁矿赐予郝家，大家意下如何？”
一次性赏金五百两，已经可以说是很大方了。
像郝家这种小家族，一年的收入估计也就仅此而已。
至于溪眉山的那座铁矿，储量不高，开采又复杂。
对于李家来说如鸡肋一般，食之无味，弃之可惜。
倒不如送给郝家，做个顺水人情，收买人心。
这一次，就连吝啬的三长老都没说些什么。
看到大家都没有异议。
李行歌于是道：“大长老还有什么要说的吗？”
大长老摇了摇头。
content_en:
The next morning.
Green Maple Valley, family meeting hall.
Six family elders were already waiting in the meeting hall early.
"Second Elder, I didn't expect you to break through to the Great Perfection of the physical body without saying a word. It's really gratifying and congratulatory."
Several elders smiled happily and congratulated the second elder.
The second elder laughed, stroked his beard, and said humbly: "It's just a fluke. You guys must work harder. Time is running out, and there is not much time left for us old guys."
Third Elder Li Xuanyong sighed.
He shook his head and said: "My qualifications are too poor, and this may be the case for the rest of my life. I'd better look after the money bag for the head of the family."
When everyone heard this, they all smiled.
Several people chatted without saying a word.
Until outside the door, a loud voice sounded...
"The master of the house is here!"
Li Xingge strode in with steady steps.
After Li Xingge took his seat as the head of the family, Da Ma Jin Dao, all the elders except the eldest elder stood up together, cupped their hands and said, "I have met the head of the family."
"Elders, please take a seat."
Li Xingge said with a smile.
Seeing everyone sitting back down again, Li Xingge announced that today's family council had officially begun.
"Master, the specific casualties of the battle with the Mangshan Su clan have been calculated."
The Great Elder spoke first.
"In this battle, 17 of our Li family monks died and 9 were injured and disabled. All of them were Body Forging Realm monks."
After listening, Li Xingge nodded and said with a heavy expression.
"Those from my Li family who died in the war will be given a one-time pension of fifty taels, and those who are disabled will be given twenty taels. We will then arrange appropriate errands based on their own circumstances. Anyone who participates in the war will be given a reward of five taels."
Everyone had no objections to Li Xingge's arrangement.
At this time, the first elder said again: "Master, in this battle, the Hao family fought for my Li family and also suffered a lot of casualties. Should my Li family also show some expression? Otherwise, I am afraid that the world will feel cold and call my Li family cold."
Li Xingge thought for a while and felt that the elder was right. In the battle to destroy the Su family, the Hao family contributed a lot.
The head of the Hao family, whom he gave the name Hao Zhongli, even beheaded a physical monk from the Su family.
So he nodded and said: "The elder is right, so I will give you a reward of five hundred taels. In addition, what do you think about the small iron mine in Ximei Mountain being given to the Hao family?"
A one-time reward of five hundred taels can be said to be very generous.
For a small family like the Hao family, their annual income is estimated to be just this.
As for the iron mine in Ximei Mountain, its reserves are not high and mining is complicated.
To the Li family, they are like chicken ribs, tasteless to eat and a pity to throw away.
It's better to give it to the Hao family, just to be a favor and win people's hearts.
This time, even the stingy third elder didn't say anything.
I saw that no one had any objections.
Li Xingge then asked: "Great Elder, is there anything else you want to say?"
The great elder shook his head.
